def transform(grid):
    # The non-background motif is copied with its central repeated-color cell
    # aligned to each isolated marker.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg]
    # Isolated markers have the color occurring most often among the sparse
    # canvas dots, while the compact motif is the largest clustered component.
    comps = []
    seen = set()
    for p in pts:
        if p in seen: continue
        stack = [p]; seen.add(p); comp=[]
        while stack:
            r,c=stack.pop(); comp.append((r,c))
            for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                q=(r+dr,c+dc)
                if q in pts and q not in seen:
                    seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
        comps.append(comp)
    motif_comp = max(comps, key=len)
    mr0=min(r for r,c in motif_comp); mr1=max(r for r,c in motif_comp)
    mc0=min(c for r,c in motif_comp); mc1=max(c for r,c in motif_comp)
    motif = {(r-mr0,c-mc0):grid[r][c] for r,c in motif_comp}
    # Use the center of the motif's repeated-color spine as its origin.
    freq=Counter(grid[r][c] for r,c in motif_comp)
    main=freq.most_common(1)[0][0]
    mainpts=[(r-mr0,c-mc0) for r,c in motif_comp if grid[r][c]==main]
    origin=(round(sum(r for r,c in mainpts)/len(mainpts)), round(sum(c for r,c in mainpts)/len(mainpts)))
    marker_color=max((v for v in counts if v!=bg), key=lambda v: counts[v])
    markers=[(r,c) for r,c in pts if grid[r][c]==marker_color and (r,c) not in motif_comp]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c in markers:
        for (a,b),v in motif.items():
            rr,cc=r+a-origin[0],c+b-origin[1]
            if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w: out[rr][cc]=v
    return out
PY
